text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick update 1 - Owen's new hire (Tess, Infra PM) starts Mon 9am PT. I made a terse manager "GPS" you can paste into calendar invites + a who-to-ask grid.
Owen (Hiring Manager): Thanks Maya. I want a single-sheet plan I can hand to Tess on Day1. Can we get laptop + repo access pre-provisioned?
Sam (IT): Device order placed. Owen  confirm Mac or Linux and whether Tess needs an external monitor. Also tell me which Slack channels to auto-join.
Owen (Hiring Manager): MacBook Pro 14, add to #infra, #oncall, #infra-squad. Cloud groups: aws-staging-read, ci-trigger-dev.
Maya (People Ops): Paste-able manager GPS (short):
```
Manager GPS - first week (copy to calendar invite):
- Before Day1: Okta + device order (IT), Slack + calendar invites (People Ops), signed offer in #people-ops-private (manager).
- Day1 AM (9:00): 20m manager intro - mission, first 30/60/90 goals, who-to-ask chart. Buddy intro (10m), badge & SSO + MFA smoke test.
- Day1 PM: 1pm "first-week map" walk-through with buddy; 3pm shadow oncall or infra run.
- Day2: Dev env + repo access, run a low-risk sandbox task (rotate demo secret + open PR).
- Week1: daily 15m check-ins (manager/buddy), runbook tour, assign mentor sessions & schedule 30/60/90 check-ins.
- Feedback cadence: day3 quick sync, week2 check, week4 review.
30/60/90 sample goals: 30 - map key services & ship small refactor; 60 - own a backlog area; 90 - lead a reliability improvement and present to team.
```
Owen (Hiring Manager): Love that. Can you also add a "who-to-ask" micro-grid I can give Tess?
Maya (People Ops): Sure - micro-grid: IT = device + SSO; Security = creds & TTLs; Buddy = day-to-day questions; Oncall = incident walkthru; Docs = runbooks & infra README.
Kai (Buddy): I'll be Tess's buddy. I'll send a 1pm Day1 coffee invite and attach a 1-pager with quick links and the "who-to-ask" micro-grid.
Pri (Security): We'll provide a 10-min secrets hygiene walk and a short pre-read (secrets-quickstart.md). For onboarding task: sandbox tokens only, no prod creds.
Sam (IT): Provisioning sandbox service account with 1h TTL tokens. I'll DM Tess the ephemeral token flow and confirm laptop imaging ETA (Fri EOD).
People Ops Bot: New-hire checklist created: https://onboard.example/2276543210 :tada:
Owen (Hiring Manager): Also adding a manager note: identify first PR reviewer and primary doc owner for each onboarding task. Saves time on day2.
Maya (People Ops): Added manager note and feedback cadence to the GPS. Owen - please upload signed offer to #people-ops-private when convenient.
Kai (Buddy): Suggest adding a calendar-timezone visibility note so remote hires see invites correctly. Small but helpful.
Maya (People Ops): Added timezone tip. Anything else?
Owen (Hiring Manager): Can Security block a 15m slot Mon 4pm for an interactive Q&A?
Pri (Security): Blocked Mon 4pm. Will attach the 6 quick actions checklist and send a 5-min pre-read.
Owen (Hiring Manager): Great. Thanks team :raised_hands:
